metadata.title: A localized Gaussian-witness lower bound for fractional iterated area on uniform grids
metadata.description: For independent standard fractional Brownian components with the same fixed H in (1/4,1), this note gives a localized Gaussian-witness proof that every square-integrable estimator of the canonical iterated integral integral_0^T B^1 dB^2, based on both complete uniform grids, has RMS error at least c_H T^(2H)n^(1/2-2H), with an explicit positive H-only constant, for every T>0 and integer n>=1. Brownian exact optimal error and smooth asymptotic rate are prior results. Local Fourier covariance bumps and Gaussian projection have established antecedents. Historical theorem and method priority, full novelty, and worldwide current-open status remain UNKNOWN; the inspected primary controls did not contain a matching rough conditional lower theorem. Canonical-area existence and sufficient L2 convergence are the external inputs; exact Euler coefficients of the pinned NTU arXiv v1 are not endorsed. No sharp constant, exact limit, endpoint, H-uniform, nonuniform/adaptive, unequal-H or correlated-component claim is made. Prepared with extensive AI assistance; unrefereed and not formally certified. Preparation and later-review status are recorded in STATUS.json and the dated preparation reports.
